title: The Agent Loop: Tool Use, ReAct, and Memory from Scratch
description: Learn how to build a production-ready AI agent from first principles: master function calling, ReAct loops, and memory design in Python, avoiding common…
linkedinHook: Your LLM chatbot just confidently told a customer their order was delivered, despite the tracking showing it's still in the warehouse. Why? Because it couldn't act.
linkedinBody: This post breaks down how to give your AI agency: integrating external tools, managing conversation memory, and building the iterative ReAct loop. We'll even build a small framework in Python. This is how you make LLMs go beyond chat and actually get work done.
